cells.1 Introduction!A1: SHEET 1 - INTRODUCTION : BEST ETHYLENE PCF CALCULATOR  V2.0
cells.1 Introduction!B8: Calculates the cradle-to-gate product carbon footprint of specification-compliant ethylene (steam cracking of ethane, LPG, naphtha, condensate or gas oil; methanol-to-olefins from natural-gas or coal methanol) following the BEST Technical Methodology for Ethylene v2 (July 2026). Complete this blank template with facility-specific activity data and traceable emission factors.
cells.1 Introduction!B11: The assessment covers emissions from feedstock and material supply through ethylene production at the factory gate (cradle-to-gate). It includes upstream production of feedstocks, fuels and auxiliary materials, inbound transport not already inside a factor, on-site processing (cracking / MTO, decoking or catalyst regeneration), fuels and utilities, direct process and fugitive emissions, waste treatment and applicable carbon capture. Distribution of ethylene after the gate, downstream manufacturing, use and end-of-life are excluded.
cells.1 Introduction!B14:
- Declared unit: 1 t specification-compliant ethylene at the factory gate (measured purity is information only).
- Result unit: t CO₂e per t ethylene, reported to 3 significant figures; AR6 GWP-100 for direct gases; location-based electricity (Annex B.1.4 delivered grid factor; on-site generation through its fuel; market-based shown separately).
- One workbook per production route; interpret the PCF with its breakdown, allocation (mass, or LHV of the whole pool when hydrogen is sold), data quality (screening DQR, data-source shares), assumptions and the three statuses (calculation · benchmark eligibility · verification).
cells.1 Introduction!B17: Read the Instructions sheet, complete the applicable input sheets, and resolve all blocking validation issues before reporting the result.
cells.1 Introduction!B20: ="Data mode: "&DataMode&"   ·   Calculation: "&calc_status&"   ·   Benchmark: "&bench_status&"   ·   Verification: "&verif_status&"   ·   PCF: "&IF(n_block>0,"blocked",TEXT(pcf,"0.000")&" tCO₂e/t")
cells.2 Instructions!B5: STEP 1 — DEFINE THE FACILITY AND PRODUCT (Setup): facility, country, location, reporting year and the 12-month reporting period (rows 61–69), factor region, production route and installed quench configuration, LPG split (LPG route), product-specification evidence (C25–C27), biogenic declaration, measurement basis of Nm³ and GJ entries (C70–C71) and verification status (C77–C79). Measured purity (C23) is information only: it never changes the PCF, the declared-unit mass or benchmark eligibility.
cells.2 Instructions!B6:
STEP 2 — ENTER MATERIAL AND PRODUCTION DATA (Sheet 4):
(i) fresh feedstocks (optional purchases / stock change in cols Z–AA reconcile to consumption); (ii) dilution steam and process water; (iii) catalysts and adsorbents — always included, never cut off; (iv) process chemicals with a Used / Not used / Not reported declaration (col P); (v) refrigeration circuits; (vi) ethylene and co-products with their disposition (sold / internal fuel / recycle) — optional prices in cols U–V feed the economic-allocation sensitivity only; (vii) decoking or MTO regeneration, non-CO₂ gases (LDAR), flare and vent streams; (viii) wastes (declare Yes / No / Not reported) and wastewater.
Give carbon fractions where requested; blank = not reported, enter 0 only for a confirmed zero. Enter ethylene output at Production Input F115.
cells.2 Instructions!B7:
STEP 3 — ENTER ENERGY AND UTILITIES (Sheet 5):
Record each fuel stream ONCE in the 5.3 fuel ledger with quantity, unit, properties and its end-use split (furnaces, boilers / HRSG, other heaters, power generation, flare pilot, mobile, other — total 100 %).
Electricity: total consumption (C7) and grid import (C8, 0 if none). On-site generation (A2): one row per generator — a gas turbine, engine or CHP links its 5.3 fuel stream (that stream carries the "Power generation" share); a steam turbine or expander driven by steam already produced on site selects "None — driven by steam/heat already counted". Steam (B1): boilers link their 5.3 stream ("Boilers / HRSG" share); a CHP / HRSG or furnace waste-heat unit adds no fuel. Purchased steam (B2) gets the supplier or Annex B.1.5 factor. Then water and industrial gases. Contractual electricity instruments need evidence (A4).
cells.2 Instructions!B8:
STEP 4 — ENTER TRANSPORT DATA
Include relevant inbound transport and waste-haulage activities that are not already covered by the selected emission factors.

Check each factor’s boundary before adding transport. Record the transported quantity, mode, distance, and other required assumptions. Identify separate transport legs clearly and avoid duplicate entries.

Exclude outbound distribution of ethylene after the factory gate.
cells.2 Instructions!B9:
STEP 5 — COMPLETE WASTE AND CARBON CAPTURE DATA (Sheet 7):
Specify the treatment route of each waste and wastewater stream. For CO₂ capture (7.2) give the capture point, the CO₂ measured before capture, the captured and vented quantities, purity, the chain energy and materials (and where they are counted), transport, losses, destination, permanence, MRV, verification and claim ownership, and confirm the chain in 7.4. Only stored CO₂ with the complete evidence set is deducted (Eq 16); chain emissions always stay in gross.
cells.2 Instructions!B10: STEP 6 — REVIEW FACTORS, ALLOCATION AND DATA QUALITY: on Sheet 10 col R shows the Factor ID used; its source, table/page, data year, geography, technology, GWP basis and verification status are held once on the hidden sheet "Factor Metadata". Prefer verified supplier PCFs, especially for the feedstocks (typically the largest term). To use your own factor, enter it in Sheet 10 col M with its source and calculation in col N and its boundary in col Q (several suppliers: enter the quantity-weighted factor). Allocation: mass by default; LHV of the whole pool when hydrogen is sold (BEST Ethylene v2 Eq 1a). Then complete sheet "8 DQR Assessment": answer the yellow questions per emission source (Unknown is an answer; blank is not), select the current Factor ID in col P, and answer the compatibility checks (section C). Section 8.3 Step 1: the tier proposed from your answers (col AM) is used unless you select a tier yourself in col AN and justify it in col AO. DQR answers never change factors or emissions.
cells.2 Instructions!B11:
STEP 7 — CHECK AND REVIEW THE RESULTS. Fix every BLOCK (data missing or inconsistent; result not usable). Replace every PROVISIONAL factor (value not confirmed). Explain every WARN. Three statuses are shown. Calculation: BLOCKED / PROVISIONAL / READY.
 
Benchmark eligibility: may the PCF be compared with BEST tiers. Independent verification: your declaration; the workbook cannot verify. READY means the checks passed, not that the PCF is verified. Review drivers, assumptions, exclusions, allocation evidence and DQR.
cells.2 Instructions!B12: CELL HELP: Yellow = input; green = editable default; grey = calculated (never type over grey cells — B24 detects it); light blue = key result. The full issue list and factor list on Results are in hidden rows 135–225 (unhide to view). Example case: Setup C46 = "Example case (illustrative)" — every illustrative value is labelled in its source column.

cells.8 DQR Assessment!A1: SHEET 8a · DATA QUALITY ASSESSMENT — screening DQR of the factor actually used   [INPUT: yellow cells only]
cells.8 DQR Assessment!A2: One row per emission source. The workbook retrieves the factor actually used (its Factor ID, source, data year and geography) from the hidden sheet "Factor Metadata". You only answer factual questions (yellow): does the factor represent your technology / route, how were the activity data obtained, were they independently verified — and, for an override or own factor, its data year, geography and type. Then confirm the answers for the current Factor ID (col P). Scores follow the BEST Ethylene v2 Section 8.3 tier table: 1 = highest data quality … 5 = lowest; the composite DQR is weighted by each source's share of gross emissions (Section 8.3 Step 2). The DQR never changes a factor value or an emission. Step 1 (tier selection): the tier proposed from your factual answers (criteria met) is used unless you select a tier yourself in col AN and justify it in col AO; the selection and the proposed tier are both shown in the limitations.

cells.8 DQR Assessment!B76: D · How your answers are scored (rules and matrix kept once, on the hidden sheet Factor Metadata, columns AD–AK)
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C77: Time · Geography · Technology · Precision. Each is met (1) or not (0) from the source record and your answers. Score = BEST Ethylene v2 Section 8.3 tier table: 0 met → 5 · 1 → 4 · 2 → 3 · 3 → 2 · 4 → 2, or 1 when independently verified.
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C78: Met when the underlying data year of the factor is within 3 years of the reporting year (Section 8.3 table: supplier PCF valid ≤ 3 years). Data year not stated in the source → not met; a projection (data year after the reporting year) → not met. Physical constants and GWP values are not time-dependent → met.
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C79: Met when the factor represents the plant country (Setup C7). Regional or global averages → not met. Overrides: Q5.
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C80: "Yes — same technology / route" → met. Partly, No or Unknown → not met.
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C81: Met when the activity data are measured or calculated from measurements for the full period AND the factor is site-specific, supplier-specific or a physical property. Database averages, defaults and proxies → not met.
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C82: Only "Yes — verification reference held" allows a score of 1 (tier 1: measured, site-specific, verified).
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C83: "Unknown" is an answer (conservative: criterion not met; assessment complete). A blank = "Assessment incomplete": scored as not met and excluded from the assessed coverage. Col P must show the current Factor ID; if the factor changes, the row says RECONFIRM.
cells.8 DQR Assessment!C84: TfS primary-data share (as in BEST PE V3; not an ethylene requirement): share of gross emissions whose activity data are measured for the period and whose factor is site- or supplier-specific and within 3 years. The estimated carbon residual is never primary data.
cells.8 DQR Assessment!B87: E · Data-source hierarchy — share of gross emissions by the data type of the factor used (BEST Ethylene v2 Section 8.1 mandatory disclosure)
cells.8 DQR Assessment!B93: Not classified (no factor identified or answers missing)
cells.8 DQR Assessment!B94: Tiers come from col W (data-type tier of the factor actually used). Shares cover gross emissions (each tonne counted once). Ethylene v2 Section 8.1 asks for these five classes; the TfS PDS (J5) is shown in addition.

cells.12 Verification!A1: SHEET 12 · VERIFICATION CHECKLIST — BEST Ethylene v2 Annex D (verification areas)
cells.12 Verification!B5: ☐ Product and period: product grade, declared unit (1 t specification-compliant ethylene), route, facility and 12-month reporting period defined (Setup C6–C25, C61–C69).
cells.12 Verification!B6: ☐ Boundary: cradle-to-gate, upstream feedstocks included, downstream stages excluded (Results boundary statement).
cells.12 Verification!B7: ☐ Completeness: all inputs, HVPs, internal streams, utilities, emissions and waste addressed — no BLOCK, no undeclared item (W24), "Not reported" items justified (W25).
cells.12 Verification!B8: ☐ Data hierarchy: supplier-specific / primary data where available; defaults documented (Sheet 10 col R → Factor Metadata); data-source shares and DQR reported (sheet 8a, coverage 100 %).
cells.12 Verification!B9: ☐ Allocation: pool, excluded streams (Setup C76) and factors correct; shares sum to 1; hydrogen sold → LHV of the whole pool; sensitivity reviewed.
cells.12 Verification!B10: ☐ Internal energy: internal fuel gas and furnace waste-heat steam counted once; carbon residual and site carbon difference explained (Sheet 4 Section 4.11).
cells.12 Verification!B11: ☐ Electricity: location-based result present (Annex B.1.4 grid factor; on-site generation through its 5.3 fuel); contractual instruments meet tracking / retirement rules (Sheet 5 A3–A4).
cells.12 Verification!B12: ☐ CO₂ capture: source, chain emissions, permanence and claim ownership verified, or deduction held (Sheet 7).
cells.12 Verification!B13: ☐ Cut-offs: individual and cumulative exclusions within limits (≤ 2 % of the PCF in total); catalysts included.
cells.12 Verification!B14: ☐ Calculations: units, GWP basis (Factor Metadata col O), LHV/HHV basis (Setup C71) and equations consistent; no formula error (B23); no overwritten calculation cell (B24).
cells.12 Verification!B15: ☐ Reporting: all Section 8.1 mandatory fields complete (Results product declaration); public / procurement / label use only after independent third-party verification (Setup C77–C79).
